claims.statement: When an authorization sets token_access_type=offline, /oauth2/token returns a long-lived refresh token alongside the short-lived access token; it does not expire automatically (unless an expiration is requested), can be reused, and is exchanged at /oauth2/token with grant_type=refresh_token for new access tokens.

sources.supports: a refresh_token inside your access token payload ... will return a short-lived access token and a refresh token, which should be securely stored
This refresh token is long-lived and won't expire automatically. It can be stored and re-used multiple times.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Candidate documented at existence level only. The pages read state no prefix, alphabet or length for the refresh token, and do not say whether it is opaque.
